You are prompted
your room + its occupants
events seen since your last turn
your tasks · legal actions

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
You pick one action
MOVE · DO [FAKE] TASK
KILL · VENT · REPORT
CALL MEETING

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Engine executes it
event shown to your room only
real + fake tasks both look
like 'Seemingly doing task'

span.p:
Win check
Crew: tasks done or Impostors gone
Impostors: parity or timeout
MEETING PHASE — everyone moved to Cafeteria

span.p:
Discussion — 3 rounds
each player SPEAKS once per round
statements shown verbatim to all

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Voting
VOTE a player or SKIP
ballots secret until tally
plurality ejected · tie = no one

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

who-voted-for-whom and ejection
